judgments.reason: The span 'right lower‐extremity numbness and pain' appears literally in the vignette and clinically supports lateralizing the peroneal neuropathy to the right side.

The span 'manual muscle testing of the right tibialis anterior and extensor hallucis longus was 3/5' appears literally in the vignette; tibialis anterior and extensor hallucis longus are muscles innervated by the peroneal nerve, supporting right-sided peroneal neuropathy.

The span 'Initial peroneal‐nerve conduction studies revealed a motor conduction velocity of 51.5 m/s' appears literally in the vignette and directly references peroneal nerve conduction, supporting the diagnosis of right peroneal neuropathy.

The span 'Repeat peroneal conduction studies failed to elicit an evoked myogenic potential' appears literally in the vignette and directly supports peroneal nerve pathology, consistent with right peroneal neuropathy.
